Vercel Pro is $20 per month as a platform fee, but how seats are priced is described differently across sources.

- **Official docs:** The Pro platform fee is $20 per month, and it includes one deploying team seat and $20 in monthly usage credit. ($20/month Pro platform fee, 1 deploying team seat included, $20/month in usage credit)
- **Extra seats:** A third-party pricing FAQ says additional deploying Owner or Member seats cost $20 each per month, while Viewer seats are free. (8-15)
- **Usage:** Usage beyond the included allowances and credit is billed on demand. (8-16)
- **Conflicting framing:** Several third-party guides describe Pro as $20 per user or per developer seat. (7-2, 9-12) Those descriptions are consistent with the seat pricing above, but they omit the platform-fee framing.

I ran one search, so I didn't check vercel.com/pricing directly. Some of these sources are dated 2026 and note that prices change, so confirm on the official pricing page before budgeting.

content.content:
**Pro plan: $20/month base price**

- **Seats:** Developer seats are $20/month each. Viewer seats are unlimited, and one billing seat is included.
- **Included usage:** The page says "Pro plans have a $20 included credit to use across resources." Beyond that, most Pro usage items list only pay-as-you-go rates. The exceptions are CDN Requests (10M/month included) and Fast Data Transfer (1TB/month included).
- **Overage:** Pro allows pay-as-you-go usage beyond the credit, with no stated cap.
- **Key limits:**
  - Custom firewall rules: up to 40
  - IP blocking: up to 100
  - System bypass rules: up to 25
  - Custom environments: 1
  - Rolling releases: 1 project included
  - Microfrontends: 2 included projects
  - Runtime logs: 1 day (30 days with Observability Plus)

content.text:
Vercel's Pro plan costs **$20/month**, according to the official pricing page.

- **Seats:** Each paid developer seat is $20/month. Viewer seats are unlimited and free, and one billing seat is included.
- **Usage credit:** The plan includes $20 of monthly credit to spend across resources. It also includes 10M CDN requests and 1 TB of Fast Data Transfer per month.
- **Overage:** Usage beyond the credit and allowances is pay-as-you-go, with no stated cap.
- **Limits:** The pricing page lists 40 custom firewall rules, 1 day of runtime logs, and 2 included microfrontends projects.

The sources describe the seats slightly differently. The pricing page and third-party guides say $20 per developer seat. The docs describe a $20 platform fee that includes one deploying seat. Either way, a solo developer pays about $20/month. Extra deploying seats are $20 each. Check the pricing page before budgeting, since prices change.

Sources:
- [Vercel Pricing](https://vercel.com/pricing)
- [Vercel Pro Plan docs](https://vercel.com/docs/plans/pro-plan)
